title: Coconut latent and thought budget routing
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for routing reasoning tasks across four compute regimes, compressing verbose multi-turn traces into continuous latent state plus invariant checkpoints and halting repetitive overthinking cycles.
boundaries: AdaptiveReasoningBudgetRouter maps task complexity, Shannon ambiguity entropy and token or latency caps across zero_step_direct, fast_sketch, compressed_state_checkpoint and full_deliberative_verify.

LatentStateSketchCompressor preserves binding constraints, open obligations and 64-character SHA-256 digests while compressing verbose reasoning traces by more than 3x alongside normalized continuous latent state vectors.
OverthinkingLoopDetector halts cyclic paraphrase steps when latent-vector cosine or shingle overlap exceeds grid thresholds with zero new invariants.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.
